messages: Arjun: Heads-up — links to /observability/tracing#span-ids are 404ing in prod; page loads but fragment missing. Nina: I see it. Heading was renamed to "Trace IDs" in the recent editorial pass. Arjun: That fragment is referenced by the onboarding workshop slides and a CI validation script that runs in new-hire setup. Nina: Can we add a frontmatter alias and also emit a raw above the heading? Frontmatter handles static redirects; raw anchor covers client-side routers. Arjun: Sounds good. I'll open a tiny PR with both changes + update slide assets and the onboarding notebook links. docops-bot: link-scan scheduled for PR when opened — will post results. NewHireOps: We're planning a workshop next Tue; can we fast-track this? QA will re-run the onboarding smoke tests once CI is green. Arjun: Will fast-track and assign myself as 48h owner for post-merge verification. PR link when ready.
